patterns.note: Sparse, non-grid-based arrangement of visual elements, with images floating independently on a vast, empty canvas.
Dramatic, abrupt shift from a pure white background to a pure black background upon initial scroll.
All visual content and the white background completely disappear, revealing a solid black screen as the user scrolls down, creating an empty, stark state.
The initial view acts as a single, expansive visual canvas before transitioning entirely to an empty, dark state upon scroll, rather than revealing new content sections.

technique_notes: The site uses a full-screen canvas for initial content display, where images are freely positioned without a visible grid. Upon scrolling, all elements are animated to disappear, and the background color transitions from white to black, creating a dramatic, empty state. This effect is likely orchestrated using GSAP for scroll-triggered animations, potentially combined with WebGL/Three.js for the canvas rendering and the overall visual experience, though the scroll sequence primarily demonstrates a simple, abrupt fade to black.

design_tokens.spacing: extremely airy, with visual elements floating independently on a vast canvas.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its extreme minimalism and anti-conventional approach, presenting only a scattered collection of images on a vast white canvas, completely devoid of text or navigation. This entire visual experience then dramatically vanishes upon scrolling, leaving a stark black screen, creating an almost interactive art piece rather than a typical website.
